entities.description: A young woman with long wavy brown hair and fair skin stands behind an elderly woman, resting her hand on the older woman's shoulder and holding her hands. The young woman wears a white collared shirt with a dark red tie and has a gentle smile, while the elderly woman has short gray hair, closed eyes, and wears a navy blue cardigan over a floral shirt.

attributes.pose: standing behind, arm around shoulder, holding hands

entities.description: A young woman with long, wavy brown hair is sitting next to an elderly woman, resting her head gently against the older woman's head and placing her hand on her shoulder. The young woman is wearing a white button-down shirt with a dark red tie and brown pants, smiling softly at the camera.

attributes.pose: sitting, leaning head on elderly woman, hand on shoulder
